goal: A third registered submit strategy 'phase' lands each DONE task onto a per-phase integration branch derived from the task's phase with the full verify ladder intact, while the true base and the shipped merge/pr strategies stay byte-identical.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-worktree packages/flywheel-orchestrator

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- GitWorktreeSubmitter (prepare_sandbox branch creation, _submit, _ff_merge, _reverify, _standing_verify, _protected_violations), resolve_landing_base, build_merge_submitter, phase_of_task_file; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/_submit_registry.py -- SUBMIT_STRATEGIES; register the new strategy here
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_policy.py -- _optional_submit_strategy and its allowed-strategy set must accept the new name; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/test_submit_standing_verify.py -- keep green, assertions unmodified; also the standing-verify harness pattern to mirror
packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/test_submit_registry.py -- keep green; extend registration coverage without weakening existing assertions
references: docs/strategy.md -- the landing decision tree; every leaf stays a land or a park-with-reason
constraints: The landing base is derived per submit request from the task's phase (the phase directory name), never resolved once per process; the integration branch is created from the then-current true base on the phase's first landing, under the merge lock
Task worktrees for a phase branch off that phase's integration branch when it exists, so tasks within a phase stack and verify against what already landed there

Full verify-ladder parity on the phase branch: uncommitted-work check, protected paths, rebase-once-then-reverify, and [submit] verify all run exactly as the merge strategy runs them, with the same park kinds
The true base is never advanced by this strategy's per-task landing, and the merge and pr strategies remain byte-identical -- their existing suites pass unmodified
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: No phase-PR machinery, no archival changes, no scheduling changes -- later tasks in this phase own those surfaces
Do not change resolve_landing_base semantics for the merge and pr strategies
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Criterion 1: two tasks from one phase land in order on the phase branch while the true base SHA is unchanged from its pre-run value

Criterion 2: a base-advanced landing whose command graders re-pass but whose standing verify fails parks with park_kind standing-verify and the phase branch unchanged; a protected-path diff parks with park_kind protected-paths
Criterion 9 mutation: a harness run under strategy merge must create no flywheel/phase/* branch
Two concurrently active phases land onto two distinct integration branches without touching each other
A reused parked worktree from the same phase still lands onto the phase branch, not the true base
